current.text: His holdout is over and he is back with Detroit. He is projected to start at center with Cunningham, Robinson, Thompson and Collins.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with an undisclosed injury. Josh says he is not injured.
His conditioning is a concern because he did not train hard during the holdout without a contract.
His auction value is about 20 USD. In a mock auction he went for 19 USD.
He is a fair third to fourth round player. ESPN's rank of 23 is too high. He is the speaker's biggest fade on Detroit: never in round 2, no chance in the 20s and doubtful in the 30s.
Tobias Harris is gone, so Detroit lost creation and Duren could gain usage (projected near 25%). If his minutes go above 28 and his usage rises, he could reach the third round.
Isaiah Stewart is gone. Paul Reed is the only other center and the main backup big, so there is little frontcourt depth behind Duren.
Last season he almost tripled his self-creation volume and was efficient on those plays.
His 2026 NBA playoffs were very bad, and Paul Reed outplayed him.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, with no rest risk expected.
Detroit is projected to win 50 to 51 games and take the third or fourth seed in the East.

durable.text: He is great in the pick and roll, on the offensive glass and finishing putbacks.
He does not defend well and does not space the floor.
He is a strong FG% anchor: very high FG% on center volume.
Rebounds are a real strength, far above the top 250 pool.
He makes no threes, so 3PM is his one clear weak category.
Detroit is built on defense, and the front office wants only enough offense.

note: Duren gives a big FG% and rebound boost and costs only threes, so he fits punt 3PM builds best. His FT% (74.5% on 6 attempts) is not a real drag. The experts price him at about 20 USD, near his Yahoo average cost of 18.2 USD and below Yahoo's value of 27 USD and ESPN's 34 USD. Paying in the high teens to about 20 USD is fair, but do not chase him at ESPN's rank-23 price. Early in the season, check his conditioning after the holdout, whether the Yahoo Q tag clears, and whether his minutes go above 28 with more usage. That is the path to third-round value.
